summary: Iteration 91: tested the 5 new features (Academy Coach SSE, Evolving AI Quiz, DM unread badge, 'Scrivi' from Friends, Radio SFX toggle) + DM regression. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (quiz 3 levels x IT/EN, invalid-level fallback, no-repeat, coach SSE IT/EN with emoji structure + done:true, DM send/conversations/unread->0/thread/auth/empty-text validation). Frontend: all flows verified on mobile viewport (390x844) — Learn section renders academy-coach + evolving-quiz for anonymous users, chip and input/send stream a real AI answer, quiz level select/start/options/explanation/next + streak & best increment, unread badge shows count 2 and clears after reading, chat panel conversations/thread/send bubble/new-message friend list, 'Message' (friend-message-*) opens the thread and sends, Radio panel sfx-toggle reveals sfx-volume slider and toggles back with no console errors. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Section labels in the mandatory answer format are hardcoded in Italian in ACADEMY_COACH_SYSTEM ('⚡ Stato / Diagnosi:', '🥖 Impatto in cucina:', '⏱️ Timeline / Passo-Passo:', '🔘 Prossimo passo:'). With lang=en/de/es the body is translated but the model copies the Italian labels verbatim -> mixed-language answers. Suggest localizing the label text per language in ACADEMY_COACH_LANG.

The returned messages still carry read:false for messages that this very call marks as read (response is built before/independently of the update). Cosmetic only: conversations.unread correctly returns 0 afterwards.

ui_bugs.issue: React console error 'Encountered two children with the same key' fires twice on load (Home and when entering Learn). Non-blocking but indicates a duplicate key in a .map() (likely news/sections/stations list).
Brand title is truncated to 'Mi...' / 'M...' on 390px viewport while there is free horizontal space; sub-line 'Michel...' also clipped.

integration_issues.issue: A 401 response is logged in the console on first load for anonymous users (session/me probe). Expected functionally, but should be swallowed to keep the console clean.

issues: Two quizzes appear on the same page (new AI 'Home Baker Quiz' + legacy 'Start the quiz' static quiz further down) — potentially confusing duplication; verify it is intentional.

action_items: Localize the ⚡/🥖/⏱️/🔘 section labels of the Academy Coach prompt for de/en/es (currently Italian labels leak into translated answers).
Fix the duplicate React key warning triggered on Home/Learn load.
Optional: silence the anonymous 401 console error and un-truncate the header brand on small screens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>4000 lines) and now hosts academy, community and capo endpoints — consider splitting into routers per domain.
/api/academy/quiz clamps 'correct' into range (good defensive normalization) but does not verify options are unique/non-empty; a model returning duplicated options would still pass.
AcademyCoach.jsx reads res.body.getReader() without checking res.ok — a non-200 (e.g. missing LLM key) would throw and only show the generic 'Ops, riprova' bubble with no diagnostic.
